query:
SELECT 
  SUM(cat1) as totalCat1_Avulso,
  SUM(cat2) as totalCat2_ServExtra,
  SUM(cat3) as totalCat3_Auxiliar,
  SUM(cat4) as totalCat4_Keune,
  SUM(cat5) as totalCat5_DonAlcides,
  SUM(cat6) as totalCat6_Caixinha,
  SUM(cat7) as totalCat7_Barbiero,
  SUM(cat8) as totalCat8_Bar,
  SUM(cat9) as totalCat9_Recorrencia,
  SUM(cat1+cat2+cat3+cat4+cat5+cat6+cat7+cat8+cat9) as grandTotal,
  SUM(cat1+cat2+cat3+cat4+cat5+cat6+cat7+cat8) as totalSemRecorrencia,
  SUM(cat9) as totalRecorrencia
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE empresaSlug = 'barbiero-morumbi' 
  AND data BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-15';
